verdicts.reason: The text explicitly requires writing the artifact "in a single write, with the full content below".

The cited line only requires "All three categories evaluated, each with its heading present" and says nothing about R-numbered "- Rn:" items in the Edge Cases section, so this format check isn't supported.
The text says "**MANDATORY**: Create one or more explicit steps... Number the steps sequentially" and requires the `### Step n` headings.
Every step must record "**Target file(s)** — full path", which supports a repo-path type check.
"For every step, record: ... **Change** — what is added, altered, or removed" directly supports requiring the Change field in each step.
"For every step, record:" lists "**Verification** — what the reproduction script must exercise", which is a mandatory field in each step.
The "**CRITICAL — contract preservation**" rule warns that "A step that leaves it unstated can silently change a signature", so each step must state its contract.
The text requires writing the planning file "in a single write, with the full content below".
The text says to keep "the `### Step n [satisfies Rx]` step headings... exactly as given", which supports the heading pattern check.
The coverage section "lists every requirement... against the steps that satisfy it", which implies the steps it names must exist as headings; a should-level check is reasonable.
"Record full paths from the repository root" directly supports requiring Target to be a repo-relative path.
"Never plan a duplicate such as `module_new.py` or `ClassName_modified.java`" directly supports banning _new/_modified file names.
The completion criterion that "every step names target files" supports a should-level Target-present check.
"every step names target files, change" supports a should-level check that each step has a Change field.
"every step names target files, change, contract obligations" supports a should-level Contract-present check.
"every step names ... verification" supports a should-level check that each step has a Verification field.
"A numbered plan exists in which every step names target files" supports the Target-present check.
"every step names target files, change" supports the Change-present check.
"every step names ... contract obligations" supports the Contract-present check.
"every step names ... verification, and requirement tag" supports the Verification-present check.
